response.sql:
WITH matched_fees_orders AS (
  SELECT 
    f.feerate - f.rebrate AS net_fee_rate,
    o.mktnote
  FROM fees f
  INNER JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
),
overall_benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(net_fee_rate) AS benchmark_value
  FROM matched_fees_orders
),
pair_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    mktnote,
    AVG(net_fee_rate) AS pair_avg_net_fee_rate
  FROM matched_fees_orders
  GROUP BY mktnote
),
kept_pairs AS (
  SELECT 
    pa.pair_avg_net_fee_rate,
    ob.benchmark_value
  FROM pair_averages pa
  CROSS JOIN overall_benchmark ob
  WHERE pa.pair_avg_net_fee_rate > ob.benchmark_value
)
SELECT 
  AVG(pair_avg_net_fee_rate),
  AVG(pair_avg_net_fee_rate - benchmark_value)
FROM kept_pairs

assumptions.assumption: The benchmark is the overall average net fee rate (feerate − rebrate) calculated across all matched fees, before any grouping. When this aggregate is NULL (no matched fees or all net rates are NULL), no pairs are kept and the result returns NULL values.

alternatives.interpretation: The benchmark is the average net fee rate of the group with NULL (missing) mktnote, and only non-NULL mktnote pairs exceeding this benchmark are kept.

WITH matched_fees_orders AS (
  SELECT 
    f.feerate - f.rebrate AS net_fee_rate,
    o.mktnote
  FROM fees f
  INNER JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
),
pair_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    mktnote,
    AVG(net_fee_rate) AS pair_avg_net_fee_rate
  FROM matched_fees_orders
  GROUP BY mktnote
),
kept_pairs AS (
  SELECT 
    pa.pair_avg_net_fee_rate,
    (SELECT pair_avg_net_fee_rate FROM pair_averages WHERE mktnote IS NULL) AS benchmark_value
  FROM pair_averages pa
  WHERE mktnote IS NOT NULL
    AND pa.pair_avg_net_fee_rate > (SELECT pair_avg_net_fee_rate FROM pair_averages WHERE mktnote IS NULL)
)
SELECT 
  AVG(pair_avg_net_fee_rate),
  AVG(pair_avg_net_fee_rate - benchmark_value)
FROM kept_pairs
